  • Method Details

    • getAllUsersAsync

      public CompletableFuture<List<User>> getAllUsersAsync()
      Loads every employee that has not been removed.
      Returns:
      future holding the employees, ordered by last name then first name

    • loginAsync

      public CompletableFuture<String> loginAsync(String username, String password)
      Attempts to log in a user with the given username and password.

      Returns "blankuser" if the username is blank, "blankpass" if the password is blank, "invpass" if the password is incorrect, and "error" if there is a database error.

      Parameters:
      username - login name to look up
      password - plain-text password to check against the stored hash
      Returns:
      future holding the result of the login attempt ("blankuser", "blankpass", "invpass", "error", or the user's role)

    • addEmployeeAsync

      public CompletableFuture<User> addEmployeeAsync(String firstName, String lastName, String username, String role, String password)
      Creates an employee with all of their details in one step.

      Rejected unless: first and last name are 1-100 characters, username is 1-50 characters and not already taken, role is "manager" or "cashier", and password is at least 4 characters.

      Parameters:
      firstName - employee's first name
      lastName - employee's last name
      username - login name for the new account
      role - "manager" or "cashier"
      password - plain-text password; hashed before it is saved
      Returns:
      future holding the new employee as read back from the database

    • hashPassword

      private static String hashPassword(String username, String password) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException
      Computes the SHA-256 hash of the combination of username and password, formatted as "username:password" in lowercase hexadecimal.
      Parameters:
      username - the user's username
      password - the user's password
      Returns:
      the SHA-256 hash of "username:password" in lowercase hexadecimal
      Throws:
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if SHA-256 is not available

    • updateEmployeeAsync

      public CompletableFuture<User> updateEmployeeAsync(User user)
      Saves an employee's first name, last name, username and role. Other fields on user are ignored.

      Rejected unless: last name is 1-100 characters, username is 1-50 characters, first name is at most 100 characters, and role is "manager", "cashier" or null.

      Parameters:
      user - the edited employee; its id selects the row to update
      Returns:
      future holding the updated employee as read back from the database.

    • removeEmployeeAsync

      public CompletableFuture<Void> removeEmployeeAsync(long id)
      Hides an employee from the list. The row is kept so past orders still point at a real cashier.
      Parameters:
      id - employee id
      Returns:
      future that completes when the employee is hidden, or fails if no employee has that id

    • validate

      private void validate(String lastName)
      Validates a user's last name.
      Parameters:
      lastName - the user's last name, required, cannot be blank and cannot exceed 100 characters
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the last name is blank or exceeds 100 characters

    • validateUsername

      private void validateUsername(String username)
      Validates a user's username.
      Parameters:
      username - the user's username, required, cannot be blank and cannot exceed 50 characters
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the username is blank or exceeds 50 characters

    • sha256Hex

      private static String sha256Hex(String input) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException
      Computes the SHA-256 hash of the input string and returns it as a hexadecimal string.
      Parameters:
      input - the input string to hash
      Returns:
      the SHA-256 hash of the input as a hex string
      Throws:
